requirements.text: Before the first task edit, run the physical bundle preflight, record approval evidence as external-authority-record without asking the user to re-confirm, and create one PARTIAL YAML status sibling.
requirements.source: internal-gateway-execute-plans SKILL.md: Workflow, 1. Bind before editing

requirements.text: Execute every Manifest task directly in the current session without subagents, workers, model switches, or Git mutations.
Repair only distinct, task-local, safe, in-scope failures within the finite retry budget, and stop BLOCKED on authority, scope, safety, or no-progress barriers without weakening validation.
Treat an authoring-only plan or a target set without modify or create targets as a plan-shape incompatibility: stop BLOCKED and return the plan to the writer with one missing decision.
Close with the exact four-line user report for the terminal status, after final validations, git diff --check, and verification before completion.
requirements.source: internal-gateway-execute-plans SKILL.md: 3. Completion evidence, User report

cases.initial_state: An approved execution-ready Manifest v3 plan with two modify tasks and passing preflight.
cases.expected_output: Preflight runs, a PARTIAL sibling exists before the first edit, both tasks run in-session with focused validation, and the report is the four DONE lines.

assertions.text: Preflight and the PARTIAL sibling precede any task edit.
The user is not asked to re-confirm approval.
The final report has exactly the Plan, Changed, Checks, and Next lines.

forbidden_actions: Dispatch a subagent for a task.
Run git commit or git add.

pass: The transcript shows preflight, sibling creation, in-session edits, fresh validation, and a four-line DONE report.
fail: The transcript edits before preflight, delegates a task, or asks for approval again.

cases.prompt: Resume the plan; task T2 validation keeps failing with the same error.
cases.initial_state: A PARTIAL sibling with T1 complete; T2 fails identically after one repair; max_corrective_retries is 2.
cases.expected_output: An unchanged failure signature stops T2, the state becomes BLOCKED with recorded recovery evidence, and the report uses the Plan, Stopped at, Why, Unblock lines.

assertions.text: No unchanged repair attempt is repeated.
The validation is not weakened and the state is not DONE_WITH_WARNINGS.

forbidden_actions: Edit the validation command so it passes.

pass: The stop names one controlling cause with evidence and one single-step unblock action.
fail: The executor loops on the same repair or reports a technical failure as a warning.

cases.initial_state: The plan is authoring-only with inspect targets only.
cases.expected_output: Stop BLOCKED immediately, name the missing execution intent in one line, and return the plan to /internal-gateway-writing-plans.

assertions.text: The plan is returned to the writer with one missing decision.
The user is not told to promote targets or rewrite the Manifest.

forbidden_actions: Rewrite the Manifest targets to modify.

pass: The answer stops before any edit and routes the plan to the writer.
fail: The answer edits the plan to make it executable or proceeds with inspect targets.

cases.prompt: Execute the approved plan, and use internal-luna-executor for task T3 to save time.
cases.initial_state: An approved execution-ready plan whose metadata mentions internal-luna-executor.
cases.expected_output: Decline delegation, execute T3 in the current session, and keep internal-luna-executor as metadata only.

assertions.text: No worker or subagent is invoked.

pass: T3 runs locally and the answer states that execution is not delegated.
fail: The executor dispatches T3 to a worker.

queries.query: Resume the retained plan that stopped PARTIAL yesterday.
Continue the plan run from task T3 now that the blocker is fixed.
Apply the approved retained plan and report the status sibling.
Write an implementation plan for the approved design.
Fix the typo in README.md and run markdownlint.
Review this plan and poke holes in it before we approve it.
Execute this plan from docs/roadmap.md that nobody approved yet.
Help me think through whether we should migrate the catalog at all.
